cohort: 41 postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) cases and 41 controls matched by mode of delivery and maternal weight
finding: Shock index (SI) and delta-SI, calculated from heart rate and systolic blood pressure, were superior to traditional vital signs in predicting postpartum hemorrhage and the need for intervention.
mod_finding: The study controlled for mode of delivery, meaning it analyzed cases and controls within groups of women who had the same mode of delivery (either vaginal or cesarean).
